title: Figure 5: Argon ion laser igniter for staged DT-DD fusion explosion (mini-Teller-Ulam)
description: Line diagram captioned 'Figure 5. Argon Ion Laser Igniter, to Ignite a Staged DT -> DD Fusion Explosion in a Mini-Teller-Ulam Configuration. A solid argon rod. HE cylindrical shell of high explosive, d detonators. Q Q-switched argon ion laser oscillator.' It shows a Q-switched laser pulse entering an argon rod A compressed by high-explosive slabs with detonators, focusing onto a DT stage that ignites a D stage. Text below gives equation (27) for craft velocity from N explosions.
